scope: Educational institution and school-associated foundation financial records where disclosure, consent, or lawful audit authority exists. Financial and governance audit, not a criminal allegation engine.

taxonomy.endowment: Restricted or board-designated investment fund for sustained institutional use; distinguish donor-restricted vs board-designated.
taxonomy.ordinary_donation: Current-use charitable gift not necessarily invested in an endowment.
taxonomy.grant: Government or private grant with specific award terms; not automatically an endowment.
taxonomy.pledge: Commitment to give; not necessarily collected cash.
taxonomy.foundation: Potentially separate legal reporting entity from a school district; cannot automatically combine receipts.
taxonomy.related_party: Board member, officer, their certain family member or business connection subject to applicable conflict rules; not guilt or misconduct per se.

roles.librarian: Locate and preserve primary-source identifiers, dates, access conditions and hashes; never infer private donor names.
roles.mathematician: Recompute integer-cent balances, year-to-year continuity and coverage; explain assumptions.
roles.auditor: Evaluate legal scope, source authenticity, restrictions, exceptions and reviewer sign-off with access authority.
roles.student: Review de-identified or synthetic examples, question gaps; never exposed to private records.
roles.human_reviewer: Approve corrections, releases, lawful escalations; automated PASS never grants legal authority.

controls.name: Identify institution and legal entity
controls.test: Record governing district/college, separate related foundation/entity, EIN where lawfully public, fiscal period, jurisdiction, auditor authority.
controls.failure: Wrong entity, unverified school identity or no legal audit authority

controls.name: Preserve source records and context
controls.test: Attach original annual audited statement, IRS Form 990 where filed, Schedule D where applicable, signed gift instrument or permitted redacted copy; URLs, capture dates, exact byte hashes.
controls.failure: Synthetic or secondhand claim presented as independent source

controls.name: Classify every funding stream
controls.test: Distinguish endowment, restricted current-use gift, unrestricted donation, grant, pledge, investment return and inter-entity transfer; tag amounts as cash/accrual.
controls.failure: Treat all donations or uncollected pledges as endowment cash

controls.name: Test donor restrictions and permitted use
controls.test: Match purpose, time horizon and restrictions in authorized gift instruments to board appropriations, UPMIFA/state law and general ledger.
controls.failure: Restricted gifts spent without justified authority or missing governing instruments

controls.name: Recompute endowment rollforward
controls.test: For explicitly gross investment return: closing = opening + received gifts + gross gains/losses + signed transfers − spending − fees, in integer cents, each fund and fiscal year.
controls.failure: Negative/unexplained residual, missing year continuity or fee double count

controls.name: Inspect manager, investment and custody controls
controls.test: Reconcile investment statements to general ledger, returns, fees, related investment-manager contracts, approvals and portfolio restrictions.
controls.failure: Material investment balances unsupported or no independent custody trail

controls.name: Review documented interests and conflicts
controls.test: Compare board register, approved contracts and disclosed compensation; inspect Form 990 Schedule L/R when applicable and independent conflict recusal.
controls.failure: Apparent related-party transaction with no documented impartial approval or review

controls.name: Trace transfers without duplicate counting
controls.test: Reconcile source and recipient records for school district, foundations, grant sponsors, intermediary entities and contractors, using identifiers and dates.
controls.failure: Same transfer counted as two donations or connection inferred from names/religion/ethnicity

controls.name: Check spending and educational purpose
controls.test: Compare grants/appropriations to actual invoices, scholarships or services using appropriately redacted or aggregate evidence.
controls.failure: Proof of receipt misrepresented as proof of intended services

controls.name: Apply foreign-source reporting only in scope
controls.test: For covered higher-education institutions, test 20 USC 1011f $250,000 annual per-source aggregate reporting and applicable deadlines; do not assert it covers K-12.
controls.failure: Misapply college-only Section 117 to elementary schools or miss aggregation

controls.name: Protect students, donors and nonpublic records
controls.test: Apply FERPA, applicable state privacy/open-records rules and IRS Schedule B public disclosure limits; avoid child identities, donor home addresses and unsupported family graphs.
controls.failure: Publish protected student/donor data or privately infer networks

controls.name: Evidence judgment and correction
controls.test: Mark distinct checks PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN; require independent human review and documented rationale, correction path and legal referral when warranted.
controls.failure: Automatically declare a person guilty, a case closed or a vendor/school authorized

calculation_definition.formula: closing_cents = opening_cents + received_gifts_cents + gross_investment_return_cents + signed_transfers_cents - spending_cents - fees_cents
calculation_definition.replay: Recompute and then reverse closing by subtracting received gifts and gross return and signed transfers, adding spending and fees; do not infer donor intent from amount.

historical_evidence.method: Accept only authorized historical daily findings with capture time, scope, source locator, SHA-256 of bytes actually seen, original/corrected version relation, independent reproduction status and missing-day report.
historical_evidence.anti_conflation: GitHub commit PASS != real endowment financial audit PASS; a named donor != wrongdoing; a TV report != court finding.

applicability.minnesota_k12: District UFARS and independent financial audits apply where covered; associated foundation may be separate.
applicability.nonprofit_schools: IRS Form 990, Schedule D endowment reporting when applicable; public donor names commonly redacted.
applicability.higher_education: 20 USC 1011f covered institutions, $250,000 foreign source aggregate per calendar year; donor rules not automatic K-12 rule.
applicability.school_students: FERPA student information protected; de-identified simulated examples only in public classroom.

excluded: No children or family lineage mapped
No inference of wrongdoing from protected class or social connection
No hacking or bypass of proprietary controls
No accusation score or guilt ranking
No actual district or college ledger examined
No public posting of sensitive allegations without independent records
